status: operator-supplied references; empty until independently verified
instructions: Add one entry per landmark whose elevation you have read from an independent source.
Do not copy elevations from this repository, from the atlas itself, or from memory.
Open the region in an independent GIS on first use.
vertical_crs must state the datum the published elevation is quoted against.
Set confirmed to true only once you have checked the citation yourself.
tolerance_m must reflect the landmark's own positional and vertical uncertainty,
not the accuracy you hope the atlas has. A summit sampled on a 10 m lattice is
systematically low: the lattice cannot resolve a peak between its nodes.

entry_template.name: short label
entry_template.source: citation or URL for the published elevation
